name: Nuclei
what: A fast open-source vulnerability scanner from ProjectDiscovery that runs YAML templates against URLs and hosts. Template packs cover known CVEs, misconfigurations, exposures and technology fingerprints, and you can add private templates for your own environment.
when: To re-check your own web-facing assets quickly after a new CVE drops, to regression-test fixes, or to run a curated template set in CI against staging.
example: Update the public template pack before each engagement: `nuclei -update-templates`.
Run against one approved target with severity filter: `nuclei -u https://app.contoso.com -severity critical,high -o nuclei-app.txt`.
For a list of in-scope URLs: `nuclei -l urls.txt -t http/cves/ -rate-limit 50`.
Verify each hit manually; open tickets only for confirmed findings with template ID and evidence.
pitfalls: Community templates vary in quality; confirm findings before you escalate.
Some templates send active or exploit-like requests; never point them at systems you do not own.
Unthrottled scans against production can look like an attack and may trip WAFs; set `-rate-limit` and notify the SOC.
